title: Compact test result summary
description: Built by PREP_ASSESS.summary() from an attempt record for the richer Tests 2 results. Counts, short arrays and pattern runs only; never the full items array and never rank, percentile, readiness probability or predicted outcome fields. JSON stays under 4096 bytes.

ts.description: finished_at (else started_at) as epoch ms, 0 when unparsable

small.description: true under 5 questions: trend and bars stay hidden

acc.description: accuracy over answered; practice mastery only

avg_ms.description: mean ms per timed question, -1 when none

pace.description: exam seconds a question, -1 when unknown

best.description: longest run right in a row

slip.description: longest run wrong in a row

rec.description: [recovered, chances]: wrong answers whose next answered question is right

subj.description: weakest-first [subject key, correct, n], at most 12

trend.description: own earlier attempts [ts, raw, max], oldest first, at most 5
